newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian vehicle firm in $14 mln sale.
newsitem.headline: Algerian vehicle firm in $14 mln sale.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned company that part-manufactures and assembles cars and commercial vehicles on Sunday signed an 800 million dinar ($14.28 million) deal to supply vehicles to two top Algerian enterprises.
Societe Nationale des Vehicules Industriels (SNVI) signed the accord with the gas and electricity utility Sonelgaz and passenger carrier Societe Nationale du Transport Routier (SNTR).
Algeria's Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia hailed the contracts as an example to other leading companies to boost local industry output, said the official Algerian news agency APS.
The deal provides for SNVI sales to Sonelgaz and SNTR worth respectively 600 million dinars and 200 million dinars, said APS. It did not say how many vehicles were involved.
